name: superpowers
description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
one_liner: A framework of reusable 'skills' plus a structured development process that makes AI coding agents work more like disciplined senior engineers.
buyer: A startup engineering lead whose junior-feeling AI coding agents keep producing messy code and who wants a repeatable process to raise the bar.
business_use_cases: A startup CTO rolls it out across the team to enforce one consistent AI-assisted development methodology instead of everyone improvising prompts.
A solo founder uses it to keep a long AI-built codebase disciplined and maintainable as it grows.
A consultancy builds a 'better AI engineering practices' audit service around installing and training clients on frameworks like this.

money_ideas.idea: Paid training or workshop sessions teaching teams how to adopt the methodology effectively.
A hosted dashboard tracking skill usage and compliance across a team as a paid add-on.

steal_this: Turn the methodology into a half-day paid workshop for engineering teams drowning in messy AI-generated code, and sell it this weekend.
